newsitem.title: THAILAND: Castle Peak says investing in Cambodia.
newsitem.headline: Castle Peak says investing in Cambodia.

text.p: Thai garment producer Castle Peak Holdings Plc said on Tuesday it would set up two manufacturing plants in the Cambodian capital Phnom Penh.

In a statement issued to the Stock Exchange of Thailand, Castle Peak said it would take an 80 percent holding in Cambodia Castle Peak Garment Export Co Ltd, which will produce finished garments for export to the U.S. and Europe.
The firm has a registered capital of $1.5 million.
Castle Peak said it would establish a second firm, Cambodia CPG Garment Export Company Ltd, with a registered capital of $2 million in which it will hold an 85 percent stake.
The company will also manufacture garments for export to western markets, the firm said.
Funding for the investment will come from working capital, Castle Peak said.
